name: Nitracaine
summary: An analogue of dimethocaine with local anaesthetic and stimulant properties. The drug is often marketed in the research chemical scene as a cocaine replacement. There is little reported use of the drug.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Nitracaine is a synthetic compound classified as a local anesthetic with stimulant properties.

uses.text: Nitracaine is a synthetic compound classified as a local anesthetic with stimulant properties. It falls into the class of drugs known as local anesthetics. The presence of the nitro group (NO2) in its molecular structure contributes to its anesthetic properties.

sideEffects.en: There is little reported use of it, so little is known. Drugs of its class, the stimulants, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and, with repeated use, dependence. Local anaesthetics of this kind can also disturb the heart's rhythm.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的使用報告很少，因此所知不多。它所屬的興奮劑類藥物，可能引起心跳加快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠，反覆使用還可能導致成癮。這類局部麻醉劑也可能擾亂心臟節律。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的使用报告很少，因此所知不多。它所属的兴奋剂类药物，可能引起心跳加快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠，反复使用还可能导致成瘾。这类局部麻醉剂也可能扰乱心脏节律。

fact.en: It is a close relative of dimethocaine, which is itself a simplified copy of cocaine's local anaesthetic part, and it is sometimes sold in place of cocaine.
fact.zh: 它與地美卡因關係密切，而地美卡因本身是古柯鹼局部麻醉部分的簡化版本。它有時被用來替代古柯鹼販售。
fact.zhHans: 它与地美卡因关系密切，而地美卡因本身是古柯碱局部麻醉部分的简化版本。它有时被用来替代古柯碱贩售。
